{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [3:0] group_eq;
    wire [3:0] group_gt;
    wire [3:0] group_lt;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : groups
            assign group_eq[k] = (A[4*k +: 4] == B[4*k +: 4]);
            assign group_gt[k] = (A[4*k +: 4] >  B[4*k +: 4]);
            assign group_lt[k] = (A[4*k +: 4] <  B[4*k +: 4]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign eq = &group_eq;

    assign gt = group_gt[3]
              | (group_eq[3] & group_gt[2])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_gt[1])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_gt[0]);

    assign lt = group_lt[3]
              | (group_eq[3] & group_lt[2])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_lt[1])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_lt[0]);
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline has cross-word comparison and equality paths reaching 0.88 ns, including a relatively slow late NOR stage. The optimization targets this global comparison depth.",
  "rewrite": "Partition the operands into four unsigned 4-bit comparisons evaluated in parallel. Combine their results with explicit four-way most-significant-group priority equations. Compute equality as the reduction AND of the four group equalities, and compute both comparison directions independently.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The intended gain comes from short local comparisons followed by a shallow group-lookahead network rather than a long cross-word dependency. No mapped timing run is available here, so an improvement over 0.88 ns is a prediction, not a measured result.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The group-equality terms are shared by both comparison directions. Local comparison logic and the final lookahead network may trade area for delay. Compliance with the 547.775360 um2 area cap and zero slew/capacitance violations requires verification in the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, unsigned 16-bit inputs, scalar outputs, and combinational behavior. The most significant unequal nibble determines gt or lt; eq is asserted exactly when every nibble matches. This is equivalent for all binary input combinations, with no assumptions, storage, latency, parameters, or external dependencies."
